  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Prepare, remove the entrails by the throat before the carcass hardens (immediately after killing)."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Make an opening under the ear, fill an ox bladder with {{ing_02|Tarentine sausage meat}} and attach a tube such as the bird keeper uses to the neck of the bladder and squeeze the dressing into the ear as much as it will take to fill the body."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "Then seal the opening with parchment, close securely (with skewers) and prepare (the roast for the oven)."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Crush {{ing_03|pepper}}, {{ing_04|lovage}}, {{ing_05|origany}}, {{ing_06|laser root}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "Moisten with {{ing_07|a little broth}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "Add {{ing_08|cooked brains}}, {{ing_09|raw eggs}}, {{ing_10|cooked spelt}}, {{ing_11|gravy of the pig}}, {{ing_12|small birds (if any)}}, {{ing_13|nuts}}, {{ing_14|whole pepper}}, and season with {{ing_15|broth}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "Stuff the {{ing_01|pig}}, close the opening with parchment and skewers and put it in the oven."
    },
    {
      "step": 8,
      "text": "When done, dress and garnish very nicely, glaze the body and serve."
    }
  ],
